neighbours.label: the verbs 'prepare' and 'deliver' when they take people as their object (equip people for something, rescue people from something), as against other verbs in the same frames
fire: The school is changing its courses to better prepare pupils for university.
In the story, the king vowed to deliver his people from the invaders.
Our workshops prepare nurses for emergencies in rural clinics.
They prayed that heaven would deliver the sailors from the storm.
The aim of the camp is to better prepare young players for professional football.
Moses was chosen to deliver the tribes out of bondage.
The course prepares new teachers for their first year in the classroom.
Volunteers help prepare refugees for job interviews.
quiet: The school is changing its courses to better reflect what pupils enjoy.
In the story, the king vowed to punish the invaders for their crimes.
Our workshops teach nurses about emergencies in rural clinics.
They prayed that the storm would pass before morning.
The aim of the camp is to better understand how young players learn football.
Moses was chosen to lead the tribes across the desert.
The course gives new teachers a mentor in their first year.
Volunteers help refugees find apartments near the city.
